data.body_html:
Looking for a Marbella family boat day with jet ski, snorkeling, and paddleboarding? You’ve found the perfect combo. Depart Puerto Banús on a private charter that blends luxury, adventure, and quality time with your loved ones. Whether you choose the Mangusta 80 with a free jet ski or a smaller boat for a half-day trip, we handle the details so you can focus on fun.

Why Choose a Family Boat Day in Marbella?

Marbella’s coastline offers calm waters, hidden coves, and plenty of sunshine from May to October. A family boat day lets you escape the crowded beaches and explore at your own pace. With a licensed skipper on board, you can relax while the kids snorkel, paddleboard, or ride a jet ski. Puerto Banús is the ideal starting point—close to Cala del Faro, Cabopino, and Estepona.

Our Fleet for Family Charters

We offer boats that suit families of all sizes. The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) includes a free jet ski on any charter of 4 hours or more (€4,719 minimum). For smaller groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) start at €749 for 2 hours. All charters include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. Snorkeling and paddleboarding gear can be added on request—just ask via WhatsApp.

Jet Ski Fun for the Whole Family

Our Mangusta 80 charter comes with a jet ski included free. The skipper will give a safety briefing and supervise the ride. Kids (with adult supervision) can enjoy short spins, while adults can take longer turns. The jet ski is a highlight of the day—perfect for adrenaline seekers and first-timers alike. No license needed.

Snorkeling and Paddleboarding Adventures

We anchor at calm spots like Cala del Faro or near Cabopino for snorkeling. Bring your own mask and fins, or we can arrange gear. Paddleboards are also available—great for kids to explore shallow waters. The skipper knows the best spots for visibility and marine life. Expect to see fish, sea urchins, and maybe even dolphins.

Best Itineraries for Families

From Puerto Banús, a 4-hour charter can take you to Cala del Faro for snorkeling, then a cruise past the Golden Mile. For a full day, head to Estepona or Sotogrande for lunch at a beach club. Our skipper will customise the route based on your preferences. We recommend booking the Mangusta 80 for the jet ski option—it’s the most popular family choice.

What’s Included and What to Bring

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% VAT. Jet ski is free on the Mangusta 80. Bring swimwear, sunscreen, towels, and a camera. Snorkeling and paddleboarding gear can be arranged for an extra fee—contact us via WhatsApp to confirm.

How to Book

Ready to plan your Marbella family boat day? Contact us via WhatsApp to check availability, customise your itinerary, and add snorkeling or paddleboarding gear. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance, especially during July and August.

Frequently Asked Questions

What’s included in a family boat day with jet ski?

Our Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) includes a free jet ski for the charter, plus a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% VAT. Snorkeling and paddleboarding gear can be added on request.

How much does a family boat day cost in Marbella?

For the Mangusta 80, the minimum charter is 4 hours at €4,719 (jet ski included). For smaller boats like the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, prices start at €749 for 2 hours and go up to €2,299 for 8 hours. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

Can we bring children on the boat?

Yes, children are welcome on all our charters. Life jackets for kids are provided as part of our safety equipment. Please let us know ages and numbers when booking so we can ensure the right gear.

Do we need a license to drive the jet ski?

No, our licensed skipper handles the jet ski and gives a safety briefing. You can enjoy riding under supervision. The jet ski is included free with the Mangusta 80 charter.

Where do we depart from?

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella. We’ll meet you at the marina. From there, we can head to Cala del Faro, Cabopino, Estepona, or Sotogrande depending on your preference.

What snorkeling spots do you recommend?

Popular spots include Cala del Faro (rocky coves with clear water) and the coast near Cabopino. Our skipper knows the best locations based on sea conditions and visibility.

Can we book a half-day charter?

Yes, half-day charters are available. For the Mangusta 80, the minimum is 4 hours. For other boats, you can book 2, 4, 6, or 8 hours. Contact us via WhatsApp for custom durations.

What if the weather is bad?

We monitor forecasts closely. If conditions are unsafe, we’ll offer to reschedule or provide a full refund. Safety is our priority.
